counterfactual.change: Same bodies, G, seed and steps but dt reduced from 1/30 to 0.001; finer integration removes the energy drift, confirming coarse-dt close-encounter error as cause.

explanation: Two heavy bodies fall into a deep close encounter (separation ~0.42 at step 7, ~0.48 at step 8, comparable to softening 0.3). Even with adaptive substeps (22-32 substeps), the fixed outer dt=1/30 leapfrog integration cannot resolve the huge acceleration/velocity spike (speeds ~12), so total energy drifts monotonically downward by ~282, exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the failure.
vision_note: Two blue bodies start slightly separated and steadily approach each other across steps 5 to 6. By steps 7 to 8 they converge into a tight overlapping close encounter at the center.
